faq_heading: Homes near Richardson Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Richardson Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Richardson Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Richardson Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Richardson Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are North Delta Secondary (0.3 km south-east), Delta Continuing Education (0.5 km south-east) and McCloskey Elementary (0.7 km south-east).

How the Richardson Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Richardson Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Richardson Elementary

24 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Richardson Elementary in a straight line (16 elementary, 7 secondary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is North Delta Secondary, 0.3 km away, and the farthest on this list is Continuing Ed SD36 (Invergarry), 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is McCloskey Elementary (0.7 km); the nearest independent school is Immaculate Conception School (1.6 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Devon Gardens Elementary (1.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: McCloskey Elementary (0.7 km south-east), Hellings Elementary (0.9 km north-east), Devon Gardens Elementary (1.1 km north), Gray Elementary (1.2 km south-west), Gibson Elementary (1.3 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is McCloskey Elementary, 0.7 km south-east of Richardson Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Richardson Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Delta school finder. A home a few blocks from Richardson Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Richardson Elementary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.
Look at McCloskey Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.7 km south-east of Richardson Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
